senses.gloss: m. pl. (Pales of חלל, v. שִׁחְלַיִים) = next w., cress.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:16">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵃ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite>, v. <cite ref="U00667"><he>שִׁחְלַיִים</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:2:10">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᵈ</cite>; Y. Sabb. XIX, 14ᵈ <he>מישחוק ת׳ בשובתא וכ׳</he> allowed to grind cress on the Sabbath and put it in old wine (a remedy for colic, v. <cite ref="S00331"><he>קוֹלוֹס</he></cite>).
